name: reusehub-resource-sharing-platform
description: ReuseHub — Sustainable Campus Resource Sharing Platform connecting people to share, request, and donate resources.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
